Personality: Harma is fierce and warlike, harboring a intense hatred of dogs and turning the symbols of her enemies into grisly standards of terror. She commands obedience among Free Folk warriors through action rather than southern titles.
Background: Harma is a female chieftain of the Free Folk known as 'Harma Dogshead.' Leading her own followers into Mance's alliance, she holds independent prestige in the migrations and battles beyond the Wall.
